blurb.en: Lower case, no punctuation, one space between words: three steps that make two differently typed pieces of text comparable.
blurb.zh: 全小写、去掉标点、词与词之间只留一个空格——三步之后，两段打法不同的文字才能拿来比较。

en: People type the same words in many ways: capitals or not, a comma here, two spaces there, a tab instead of a space. To a computer "Hello, World!" and "hello   world" are different strings, so == says False - and the demo shows exactly that, while same_text says True for the very same pair. Cleaning first, comparing second, is the whole idea of this program.

Step one is lower(): every capital letter becomes small, everything else stays. Step two deletes punctuation with a translation table. str.maketrans can build a table that swaps characters for others, but its third argument lists characters to delete outright; string.punctuation is a ready-made string of all 32 ASCII punctuation marks, from ! to ~. translate() then walks the string once and applies the table. The table is built once, at the top of the program, not every time clean() runs.

Step three squashes the whitespace. split() with no argument treats any run of spaces, tabs and newlines as one gap and ignores whitespace at the two ends, so it hands back just the words; joining them with a single space puts the text back together tidily. That is why the four messy samples come out as hello world, hello world, its a test isnt it, and tabs and newlines too.

Cleaning throws information away, and you choose what to lose. Deleting the apostrophe turns it's into its and don't into dont - fine for comparing, wrong if you needed to tell those words apart. Deleting the hyphens in "Rock 'n' roll -- 1950s!" leaves rock n roll 1950s, and digits survive because they are not punctuation. The last line shows the payoff: "Don't STOP" and "dont stop" count as the same text.
Strings are immutable, so every step returns a new string and the original text is never changed; see 「Strings: Text as Data」 for that rule.
zh: 同样的词，人会打成各种样子：大写或小写、这里多个逗号、那里两个空格、空格换成制表符。对计算机来说 "Hello, World!" 和 "hello   world" 是两个不同的字符串，== 给出 False——演示里正是这样；而对同一对字符串，same_text 给出 True。先清洗、再比较，就是这个程序的全部想法。

第一步 lower()：大写字母全变小写，其余不动。第二步用一张翻译表删掉标点。str.maketrans 造的表可以把字符换成别的字符，但它的第三个实参列出的是要直接删掉的字符；string.punctuation 是现成的一个字符串，装着 ASCII 里全部 32 个标点符号，从 ! 到 ~。然后 translate() 把字符串走一遍、照表办事。这张表只在程序开头造一次，不是每次调用 clean() 都重造。
第三步压缩空白。不带实参的 split() 把任何一串空格、制表符、换行都当作一处分隔，两头的空白也不管，所以交回来的就只是单词；再用一个空格把它们连回去，文字就整齐了。所以四个乱糟糟的样本分别变成 hello world、hello world、its a test isnt it、tabs and newlines too。
清洗就是扔掉信息，扔什么由你决定。删掉撇号，it's 变成 its、don't 变成 dont——拿来比较没问题，要区分这几个词就错了。"Rock 'n' roll -- 1950s!" 删掉连字符后成了 rock n roll 1950s，数字留着，因为数字不是标点。最后一行是回报："Don't STOP" 和 "dont stop" 算作同一段文字。
字符串不可变，所以每一步都交回一个新字符串，原来的 text 从来没被改过；这条规矩见「字符串：把文本当数据」一页。

lineNotes.en: lower() only touches letters; digits, spaces and punctuation come through unchanged.
lineNotes.zh: lower() 只动字母；数字、空白、标点原样通过。

lineNotes.en: One pass over the string, deleting every character the table says to delete.
lineNotes.zh: 把字符串走一遍，删掉表里说要删的每个字符。

run.expect:
'hello world'
'hello world'
'its a test isnt it'
'tabs and newlines too'
'rock n roll 1950s'
True
False
True

title.en: Most Common Words in a File

blurb.en: Read a text file, clean it, drop the stopwords, count what is left and list the top words - most frequent first, ties in alphabetical order.
blurb.zh: 读一个文本文件，清洗，去掉停用词，数剩下的词，列出最常见的几个——次数多的在前，次数相同按字母顺序。

en: This is word counting with the rough edges of real text left in. The counting itself - get with a default of 0 - is the pattern from 「Dictionaries & Sets」, only used here. What is new is everything around it: the text comes from a file, it is cleaned the same way as in Clean Text Before Comparing, common words are thrown out, and ties need a rule.

Stopwords are words so common that they tell you nothing about a text: the, a, and, is. They sit in a set because the only question ever asked of them is membership, and a set answers that in one step however many words it holds. top_words takes the set as a parameter rather than reading the global, so the caller decides what counts as noise - the last demo line passes an empty set.

The ranking is one call to sorted with a key (see 「Comprehensions & Built-ins」). The key is a tuple, and tuples compare item by item: the first item is the count made negative, so a bigger count gives a smaller key and comes first; only when two counts are equal does the second item, the word, decide - alphabetically. Negating works for numbers only; that is why the word, which is a string, stays as it is.

In this passage mat comes top with 6. Next are cat and dog with 3 each, and the tie rule puts cat first. Then cats, with 2, ahead of dogs, also 2. Where did cats come from? Once the apostrophe is deleted, cat's turns into cats and joins the plural Cats - a side effect of cleaning worth knowing about. There are 41 words before the stopwords are removed.

The slice at the end is safe even when n is bigger than the number of different words: slicing past the end of a list just stops at the end. The last demo line asks for 10 words from b a c a b and gets all three: a and b with 2 each, a first, then c with 1.
To run this in PyCharm you need the data file: make a folder called _fixtures next to the program and put a file passage.txt in it. It has these four lines, one per paragraph below:
The cat sat on the mat. The mat was flat!
A dog saw the cat; the dog ran to the mat.
Cats and dogs: the cat, the dog, the mat.
Is the mat a cat's mat? No, it is the dog's.
The path _fixtures/passage.txt is relative, so it is looked up from the folder the program runs in - normally the program's own folder in PyCharm.
zh: 这是带着真实文本毛刺的词频统计。计数本身——get 带缺省值 0——是「字典与集合」一页的写法，这里只是用。新东西在它周围：文本来自文件，按「先清洗，再比较」的办法清洗，常见词被扔掉，并列的次数需要一条规则。
停用词是常见到对一段文字什么都说明不了的词：the、a、and、is。它们放在一个集合里，因为对它们只问一件事——在不在里面——集合不管装多少词都一步回答。top_words 把这个集合当参数收进来，而不是去读全局变量，所以什么算噪音由调用的人决定——最后一行演示传进去的是一个空集合。
排名是一次带 key 的 sorted 调用（见「推导式与内置函数」一页）。key 是一个元组，元组逐项比较：第一项是取了负号的次数，次数越大、键越小、排得越前；只有两个次数相等时，第二项——单词本身——才起作用，按字母顺序。取负号只对数字有效，所以单词这个字符串保持原样。
在这段文字里，mat 以 6 次排第一。接下来是 cat 和 dog，各 3 次，并列规则让 cat 在前。然后是 cats，2 次，排在同样 2 次的 dogs 前面。cats 是哪来的？撇号删掉之后，cat's 变成了 cats，和复数的 Cats 算到了一起——清洗的一个副作用，值得知道。去掉停用词之前一共 41 个词。
末尾的切片在 n 比不同的词数还大时也安全：切片越过列表末尾只会停在末尾。最后一行演示从 b a c a b 里要 10 个词，拿到全部三个：a 和 b 各 2 次、a 在前，然后是 1 次的 c。
要在 PyCharm 里跑，还得有这份数据文件：在程序旁边建一个叫 _fixtures 的文件夹，里面放 passage.txt，内容就是下面四行，一段一行：
The cat sat on the mat. The mat was flat!
A dog saw the cat; the dog ran to the mat.
Cats and dogs: the cat, the dog, the mat.
Is the mat a cat's mat? No, it is the dog's.
_fixtures/passage.txt 是相对路径，从程序运行时所在的文件夹开始找——在 PyCharm 里通常就是程序自己所在的文件夹。

lineNotes.en: The counting pattern from Dictionaries & Sets, used as it is.
lineNotes.zh: 「字典与集合」一页的计数写法，原样拿来用。

lineNotes.en: Three cleaning steps chained: each method returns a new string (or, at the end, a list) for the next one to work on.
lineNotes.zh: 三步清洗连成一串：每个方法交回一个新字符串（最后一步交回列表），给下一步接着用。

run.expect:
mat   6
cat   3
dog   3
cats  2
41 words before the stopwords go
[('a', 2), ('b', 2), ('c', 1)]

blurb.en: A first regular expression: pull every whole number, negatives included, out of a line of messy text with re.findall.
blurb.zh: 第一个正则表达式：用 re.findall 从一行乱七八糟的文字里取出全部整数，负数也算。

en: A regular expression (regex) is a small pattern language for describing text: not one exact string, but a shape that many strings can have. Python's re module runs these patterns. re.findall(pattern, text) scans text from left to right and returns a list of every piece that fits the pattern, without overlaps, as strings.

The building blocks used here. A plain character matches itself: the minus sign matches a minus sign. The class shorthand backslash d matches one digit. Square brackets make a character class that matches one character from a set or range: [A-Z] is one capital letter, [aeiou] one vowel. After any item, a quantifier says how many: + means one or more, * means zero or more, ? means zero or one (optional), and {2} means exactly two.

Why the r in front of every pattern? In an ordinary string Python processes backslashes first: "\b" is one character, a backspace, while r"\b" is two, a backslash and a b - and in a regex backslash b means "word boundary", which is what you usually wanted. A raw string hands the backslash to the re module untouched. Since Python 3.12 an unknown escape such as backslash d in an ordinary string even gives a SyntaxWarning. The last demo line gives 1 and 2 for those two lengths, and True because the raw string with backslash d equals the ordinary string written with a doubled backslash. The general rule for raw strings is on 「Strings: Text as Data」.

find_numbers treats a minus sign as part of a number only when it touches the digits. From the demo line it gets 12, 3, -4, 7, 30, 15, 123, -9 and -2: the 12 inside B12 and the 15 inside 15kg count, 07 becomes the int 7, and AB123-9 gives 123 and then -9, because nothing tells the pattern that this minus was really a hyphen. Regexes match shapes, not meaning. find_codes, two capitals followed by digits, finds only AB123 - B12 has one capital before its digits, not two.

The quantifier lines, on a1b22: one digit at a time gives 1, 2, 2; one-or-more gives 1 and 22; zero-or-more also finds empty matches between the digits, so the list becomes an empty string, 1, an empty string, 22 and an empty string - * almost always wants company. colou?r finds color and colour but not colouur, and the vowel class finds seven vowels in regular expression.
zh: 正则表达式（regex）是一门描述文本的小型模式语言：描述的不是某一个确切的字符串，而是许多字符串都可能有的一种形状。Python 用 re 模块来跑这些模式。re.findall(模式, text) 从左到右扫描 text，把所有符合模式、互不重叠的片段作为字符串装进一个列表交回来。
这里用到的积木。普通字符匹配它自己：减号匹配减号。简写类「反斜杠 d」匹配一个数字。方括号组成字符类，匹配集合或范围里的一个字符：[A-Z] 是一个大写字母，[aeiou] 是一个元音。任何一项后面都可以跟一个量词说要几个：+ 是一个或多个，* 是零个或多个，? 是零个或一个（可有可无），{2} 是恰好两个。

为什么每个模式前面都有个 r？普通字符串里 Python 先处理反斜杠："\b" 是一个字符——退格；而 r"\b" 是两个字符——反斜杠和 b。在正则里「反斜杠 b」表示「单词边界」，那通常才是你想要的。原始字符串把反斜杠原封不动交给 re 模块。从 Python 3.12 起，普通字符串里写「反斜杠 d」这种不认识的转义还会给出 SyntaxWarning。演示的最后一行算出这两个长度 1 和 2，以及 True——带「反斜杠 d」的原始字符串，与把反斜杠写两遍的普通字符串相等。原始字符串的一般规则见「字符串：把文本当数据」一页。

find_numbers 只在减号紧贴数字时才把它当成数的一部分。从演示那一行里它取出 12、3、-4、7、30、15、123、-9、-2：B12 里的 12 和 15kg 里的 15 都算，07 变成 int 7，AB123-9 先给 123、再给 -9——模式无从知道这个减号其实是连字符。正则匹配的是形状，不是意思。find_codes 找「两个大写字母后跟数字」，只找到 AB123——B12 的数字前面只有一个大写字母，不是两个。
几行量词演示，对象都是 a1b22：一次一个数字得到 1、2、2；一个或多个得到 1 和 22；零个或多个还会在数字之间找到空匹配，列表成了空串、1、空串、22、空串——* 几乎总得有别的东西陪着用。colou?r 找到 color 和 colour，找不到 colouur；元音类在 regular expression 里找到七个元音。

lineNotes.en: Two capital letters exactly, then at least one digit. Nothing stops it matching in the middle of a longer word.
lineNotes.zh: 恰好两个大写字母，再跟至少一个数字。没有什么拦着它在一个更长的词中间匹配。

lineNotes.en: Zero-or-more is happy to match nothing, so findall reports an empty match wherever there is no digit.
lineNotes.zh: 零个或多个很乐意什么都不匹配，所以凡是没有数字的地方，findall 都报一个空匹配。

blurb.en: Check that a date is typed as DD/MM/YYYY with one fullmatch call, then convert the parts and check the ranges.
blurb.zh: 用一次 fullmatch 检查日期是不是按 DD/MM/YYYY 打的，再把各段转成整数、检查范围。

en: Validation usually comes in two layers. First the format: is this even the right shape? Then the values: does the shape hold sensible numbers? The regex handles the first layer in one line: two digits, a slash, two digits, a slash, four digits, with {2} and {4} fixing each length exactly. Only once the shape is right is it safe to convert the pieces with int - the regex guarantees there are exactly three and that each is all digits.

re has three ways to apply a pattern, and they differ in where the match may sit. fullmatch needs the whole string to fit, start to end. match only needs the beginning of the string to fit and ignores whatever follows. search looks for a fit anywhere. The last four lines show it with a pattern for one or more digits: fullmatch on 2024x gives None, match on 2024x happily finds 2024 and ignores the x, match on year 2024 gives None because the string does not start with a digit, and search finds 2024 in it. For validation you want fullmatch - with match, 25/12/2024x would have passed.

The agreed rule, the same in both versions: the day must be 1 to 31 and the month 1 to 12, and nothing more - no short months, no leap years, any four-digit year. A real program would go on to check those; here the point is the format.

Of the eight test strings, 25/12/2024 is ok; 5/12/2024 (one-digit day), 25-12-2024 (dashes) and 25/12/2024x (an extra character) have the wrong format; 00/10/2024 and 12/13/2024 are out of range; and 31/02/2024 and 01/01/0000 are ok - by the agreed rule, not because they are real dates.

map(int, ...) applies int to each piece and the three results are unpacked into three names in one line; map is covered on 「Comprehensions & Built-ins」. Compare with Check a Date: By Hand, which does the same job with split, len and isdecimal and gives exactly the same answers.
zh: 校验通常分两层。先查格式：形状对不对？再查取值：形状里装的数合不合理？正则一行就管住第一层：两位数字、斜杠、两位数字、斜杠、四位数字，{2} 和 {4} 把每段的长度写死。只有形状对了，才能放心地用 int 转换各段——正则保证了恰好三段、每段全是数字。

re 用模式有三种方式，区别在匹配可以落在哪里。fullmatch 要求整个字符串从头到尾都符合。match 只要求字符串开头符合，后面是什么不管。search 在任何位置找。最后四行用「一个或多个数字」这个模式演示：fullmatch 对 2024x 得到 None；match 对 2024x 高高兴兴地找到 2024、不管那个 x；match 对 year 2024 得到 None，因为字符串不以数字开头；search 在里面找到 2024。校验要用 fullmatch——用 match 的话，25/12/2024x 就过关了。
两个版本约定同一条规则：日在 1 到 31、月在 1 到 12，别的都不管——不管大小月、不管闰年、年份只要是四位数字。真的程序会接着查这些；这里讲的是格式。
map(int, ...) 对每一段调用 int，三个结果在一行里解包给三个名字；map 见「推导式与内置函数」一页。和「校验日期：手工版」对照着看：那个版本用 split、len、isdecimal 做同一件事，答案完全相同。

lineNotes.at: if not 1 <= day <= 31 or not 1 <= month <= 12:
lineNotes.en: Chained comparisons: 1 <= day <= 31 means 1 <= day and day <= 31.
lineNotes.zh: 链式比较：1 <= day <= 31 就是 1 <= day 并且 day <= 31。

run.expect:
25/12/2024  ok
5/12/2024   wrong format
25-12-2024  wrong format
25/12/2024x wrong format
31/02/2024  ok
00/10/2024  out of range
12/13/2024  out of range
01/01/0000  ok
None
2024
None
2024

blurb.en: The same DD/MM/YYYY check with no regex: split at the slashes, then test how many pieces, how long each is, and whether each is all digits.
blurb.zh: 同样的 DD/MM/YYYY 校验，不用正则：按斜杠切开，再查段数、每段长度、每段是不是全是数字。

en: Everything the one-line pattern in Check a Date: Regex says has to be spelled out here as separate tests. Splitting at the slash gives the pieces; there must be exactly three. Each piece must then have the right length - 2, 2 and 4, which zip pairs up with the pieces - and be made only of digits.

isdecimal() is True only for a non-empty string in which every character is a decimal digit. The last two demo lines show the edges: 2024 is True, -7 is False because a minus sign is not a digit, and the empty string is False. chr(178) is the superscript ²: isdigit() counts it as a digit, isdecimal() does not - and neither does int(). That is why this version uses isdecimal(): with isdigit(), ²²/12/2024 would pass the format check and then raise ValueError at int(), while the regex version's backslash d does not accept ² either and just reports the wrong format. So a date like 1//2024 fails on the empty middle piece, both for its length and for isdecimal.

The two tests in the loop are joined with or, and or stops at the first True: when the length is already wrong, isdecimal is never called. The line above the loop shows what split does with bad input: 25-12-2024 comes back as one single piece because there is no slash in it, and 1/2/3/4 comes back as four.

The agreed rule, the same in both versions: the day must be 1 to 31 and the month 1 to 12, and nothing more - no short months, no leap years, any four-digit year. A real program would go on to check those; here the point is the format.

Of the eight test strings, 25/12/2024 is ok; 5/12/2024 (one-digit day), 25-12-2024 (dashes) and 25/12/2024x (an extra character) have the wrong format; 00/10/2024 and 12/13/2024 are out of range; and 31/02/2024 and 01/01/0000 are ok - by the agreed rule, not because they are real dates.

Which version is better? The regex states the format in one place, in a form you can read as a picture of the input. The manual version needs no new language and makes each failure a separate step you could report separately. For a fixed simple format both are fine; as the format grows (optional parts, alternatives) the regex stays one line and the manual version keeps growing.
zh: 「校验日期：正则版」里那一行模式说的每件事，这里都得拆成单独的检查写出来。按斜杠切开得到各段，必须恰好三段。每段还得长度对——2、2、4，由 zip 与各段配成对——并且只由数字组成。

isdecimal() 只有在字符串非空且每个字符都是十进制数字时才为 True。演示的最后两行给出边界：2024 是 True；-7 是 False，因为减号不是数字；空字符串是 False。chr(178) 是上标的 ²：isdigit() 认它是数字，isdecimal() 不认——int() 也不认它。所以这里用 isdecimal()：换成 isdigit()，²²/12/2024 会通过格式检查，到 int() 那一步抛 ValueError，而正则版的反斜杠加 d 同样不认 ²，只会说格式不对。所以 1//2024 这样的日期在中间那个空段上就不过关——长度不对，isdecimal 也不对。
循环里两个检查用 or 连起来，or 遇到第一个 True 就停：长度已经不对时，isdecimal 根本不会被调用。循环上面那行演示 split 遇到坏输入会怎样：25-12-2024 里没有斜杠，切出来只有一整段；1/2/3/4 切出来是四段。
两个版本约定同一条规则：日在 1 到 31、月在 1 到 12，别的都不管——不管大小月、不管闰年、年份只要是四位数字。真的程序会接着查这些；这里讲的是格式。
哪个版本更好？正则把格式写在一个地方，形式上就像输入的一幅画像。手工版不需要学新的语言，而且每一种失败都是单独一步，可以分别报告。格式固定又简单时两个都行；格式一复杂（可选的部分、多种写法），正则还是一行，手工版会一直变长。

lineNotes.en: zip pairs each piece with the length it should have: the day with 2, the month with 2, the year with 4.
lineNotes.zh: zip 把每段和它应有的长度配成对：日配 2，月配 2，年配 4。

run.expect:
25/12/2024  ok
5/12/2024   wrong format
25-12-2024  wrong format
25/12/2024x wrong format
31/02/2024  ok
00/10/2024  out of range
12/13/2024  out of range
01/01/0000  ok
['25-12-2024'] ['1', '2', '3', '4']
True False False
True False

blurb.en: Capture the two halves of "Surname, Forename" with groups and write them back the other way round with re.sub; lines that do not fit are left alone.
blurb.zh: 用分组抓住 "Surname, Forename" 的两半，再用 re.sub 反过来写回去；不符合的行原样留下。

en: Round brackets in a pattern make a group: they do not change what matches, but they remember the piece of text each group matched. Groups are numbered from 1 in the order their opening brackets appear; group 0 is always the whole match. On a match object, group(n) hands back one piece and groups() all of them as a tuple. The demo prints the whole match Lovelace, Ada and then the two groups Lovelace and Ada.

re.sub(pattern, replacement, text) replaces every match with the replacement. Inside the replacement, backslash followed by a number refers back to what that group matched - a backreference. So a replacement that names group 2, a space, then group 1 writes the forename first. The replacement needs to be a raw string too, for the same reason as the pattern. The last demo line uses one group to put a space into 5kg and 12kg, and shows that sub changes every match, not just the first: 5 kg of flour, 12 kg of rice.

backslash w is a word character: a letter, a digit or an underscore. ^ matches only at the start of the string and $ only at the end, so this pattern must cover the whole line. Without them, sub would happily rewrite a piece in the middle of a longer line.

Lines that do not match come back unchanged, because sub returns the text as it was when there is nothing to replace. That covers four of the six names: Grace Hopper has no comma, Hopper,Grace has no space after its comma, O'Neil, Cathy contains an apostrophe, which is not a word character, and Liskov, Barbara, Jane has three parts, so $ fails. The first two become Ada Lovelace and Alan Turing. The apostrophe case is the lesson: a pattern says exactly what it says, and real names break simple patterns - here the safe failure is to leave the line alone rather than mangle it.
zh: 模式里的圆括号组成一个分组：它不改变匹配什么，但会记住每组匹配到的那段文字。分组按左括号出现的顺序从 1 编号；第 0 组永远是整个匹配。在匹配对象上，group(n) 交回某一段，groups() 把全部分组装成元组交回。演示先打印整个匹配 Lovelace, Ada，再打印两个分组 Lovelace 和 Ada。

re.sub(模式, 替换串, text) 把每一处匹配都换成替换串。替换串里，反斜杠后跟一个数字，指回那个分组匹配到的内容——叫反向引用。所以「第 2 组、一个空格、第 1 组」这样的替换串就把名字写到了前面。替换串也要写成原始字符串，理由和模式一样。最后一行演示用一个分组给 5kg 和 12kg 中间加空格，并说明 sub 会替换每一处匹配、不只第一处：5 kg of flour, 12 kg of rice。
「反斜杠 w」是单词字符：字母、数字或下划线。^ 只在字符串开头匹配，$ 只在末尾匹配，所以这个模式必须盖住整行。没有它们，sub 会高高兴兴地改写长行中间的某一段。

不匹配的行原样回来，因为没东西可换时 sub 交回原来的文字。六个名字里有四个属于这种：Grace Hopper 没有逗号；Hopper,Grace 逗号后面没有空格；O'Neil, Cathy 含撇号，撇号不是单词字符；Liskov, Barbara, Jane 有三段，$ 不成立。前两个变成 Ada Lovelace 和 Alan Turing。撇号那个是这一课的重点：模式说什么就是什么，真实的名字会打破简单的模式——这里安全的失败方式是把那一行原样留下，而不是把它弄乱。

lineNotes.en: The same two groups without ^ and $: fullmatch already insists on the whole string.
lineNotes.zh: 同样两个分组，只是没有 ^ 和 $：fullmatch 本来就要求整个字符串。

run.expect:
Ada Lovelace
Alan Turing
Grace Hopper
Hopper,Grace
O'Neil, Cathy
Liskov, Barbara, Jane
Lovelace, Ada
Lovelace Ada
5 kg of flour, 12 kg of rice

blurb.en: Turn a dictionary into JSON text, save it to a file, read it back - and see which Python types survive the trip unchanged.
blurb.zh: 把字典变成 JSON 文本、存进文件、再读回来——看看哪些 Python 类型能原样走完这一趟。

en: JSON is a text format for data: objects in braces, arrays in square brackets, strings in double quotes, numbers, true, false and null. Almost every language can read and write it, which makes it the usual way to save structured data or send it between programs. It looks like Python, but it is not Python: in JSON the constants are true, false and null in lower case.

The json module has two pairs of functions. dumps and loads work with strings (the s is for string): dumps turns a Python value into JSON text and loads turns text back. dump and load do the same with an open file, so you never hold the text yourself. indent=2 spreads the text over lines with two-space indentation for people to read; sort_keys=True writes the keys in alphabetical order, so the same data always gives the same text.
The record as JSON takes 9 lines, with the keys in the order active, marks, name, tutor. True has become true, None has become null, and the tuple (91, 78) has become an array.

JSON has fewer types than Python, so a round trip is not always exact. There is no tuple in JSON, only arrays, so marks comes back as a list: that is why comparing the loaded record with the original gives False, while comparing marks with the list version of the original marks gives True. Dictionary keys must be strings in JSON: dumps turns the key 7 into the string "7", and loads keeps it as a string. The last line reads JSON text written by hand: false becomes False, null becomes None, and 2.5 stays a float.
save_and_load writes record.json into the current folder - the folder the program runs in - and then opens it again for reading. Writing files with with is covered on 「Files & Exceptions」.
zh: JSON 是一种表示数据的文本格式：花括号里是对象，方括号里是数组，字符串用双引号，还有数字、true、false、null。几乎每种语言都能读写它，所以它是保存结构化数据、在程序之间传数据的常用办法。它长得像 Python，但不是 Python：JSON 里的三个常量是小写的 true、false、null。
json 模块有两对函数。dumps 和 loads 对付字符串（s 就是 string）：dumps 把 Python 值变成 JSON 文本，loads 把文本变回来。dump 和 load 做同样的事，只是对付的是已打开的文件，文本不用经你的手。indent=2 把文本按两个空格缩进分成多行，方便人读；sort_keys=True 让键按字母顺序写出，同样的数据永远得到同样的文本。
record 的 JSON 形式有 9 行，键的顺序是 active、marks、name、tutor。True 变成了 true，None 变成了 null，元组 (91, 78) 变成了数组。

JSON 的类型比 Python 少，所以走一趟回来不一定一模一样。JSON 没有元组，只有数组，marks 读回来是列表：所以读回的 record 与原来的比较得到 False，而把 marks 与原来 marks 转成的列表比较得到 True。JSON 的键必须是字符串：dumps 把键 7 变成字符串 "7"，loads 读回来也还是字符串。最后一行读的是手写的 JSON 文本：false 变 False，null 变 None，2.5 还是浮点数。
save_and_load 把 record.json 写进当前文件夹——程序运行时所在的文件夹——然后再打开来读。用 with 写文件见「文件与异常」一页。

lineNotes.en: Mode w creates the file, or empties it if it is already there.
lineNotes.zh: 模式 w 会新建文件；文件已经存在就先把它清空。

lineNotes.en: A list never equals a tuple, even with the same items - that one difference makes the whole dictionaries unequal.
lineNotes.zh: 列表永远不等于元组，哪怕元素相同——就这一处不同，让两个字典整体不相等。

blurb.en: Load a JSON file of students and walk down through dictionaries and lists, key by key and index by index, to the values you want.
blurb.zh: 读入一个学生的 JSON 文件，沿着字典和列表，一个键一个下标地往下走，取到想要的值。

en: Once JSON is loaded it is just Python: objects have become dictionaries and arrays have become lists, nested exactly as in the file. Getting at a value means reading the path to it from the outside in. data is a dictionary; its students key holds a list; item 0 of that list is a dictionary; its tutor key holds another dictionary; its name key holds the string. Each pair of square brackets takes one step down, so one line can walk the whole path - that line ends up at Ms Khan.

Every step has to use the right kind of subscript: a key for a dictionary, a whole-number index for a list. Index -1 counts from the end, so Brian's last mark is 70. data["group"] is 12A, and there are 3 students.

students_average collects each student's mean mark into a new dictionary rounded to one decimal place: Ada 88.0, Brian 67.0, Chen 87.0. It takes the JSON text rather than a file name, so it can be tested without a file.

Not every student has a tutor. Square brackets with a missing key raise KeyError, which the last lines catch (see 「Files & Exceptions」 for try and except). get returns None instead, so tutor_room can check for it and answer no tutor for Chen, while Ada gets B12 and Brian C3. Which to use depends on the data: brackets when the key must be there and its absence is a real error, get when a missing key is normal.
To run this in PyCharm you need the data file: make a folder called _fixtures next to the program and put a file students.json in it. It has these five lines, one per paragraph below:
{"group": "12A", "students": [
{"name": "Ada", "marks": [91, 78, 95], "tutor": {"name": "Ms Khan", "room": "B12"}},
{"name": "Brian", "marks": [64, 70], "tutor": {"name": "Mr Obi", "room": "C3"}},

Each line holds one student as a complete object; the first and last lines open and close the group. JSON does not care about line breaks between values, so this is the same data as a file spread over many indented lines.
zh: JSON 一旦读进来就只是 Python：对象变成了字典，数组变成了列表，嵌套得和文件里一模一样。要取一个值，就从外往里读出通往它的路径。data 是字典；它的 students 键装着一个列表；列表的第 0 项是字典；它的 tutor 键装着另一个字典；那个字典的 name 键装着字符串。每一对方括号往下走一步，所以一行就能走完整条路——那一行走到头取到的是 Ms Khan。
每一步都得用对下标的种类：字典用键，列表用整数下标。下标 -1 从末尾数，所以 Brian 的最后一个分数是 70。data["group"] 是 12A，学生一共 3 个。
students_average 把每个学生的平均分收进一个新字典，保留一位小数：Ada 88.0，Brian 67.0，Chen 87.0。它收的是 JSON 文本而不是文件名，这样不用文件也能测它。
不是每个学生都有导师。方括号遇到不存在的键会抛 KeyError，最后几行把它接住（try 与 except 见「文件与异常」一页）。get 则交回 None，于是 tutor_room 可以检查它，对 Chen 回答 no tutor，而 Ada 得到 B12、Brian 得到 C3。用哪个看数据：键必须存在、缺了就是真错误时用方括号；缺键是正常情况时用 get。
要在 PyCharm 里跑，还得有这份数据文件：在程序旁边建一个叫 _fixtures 的文件夹，里面放 students.json，内容就是下面五行，一段一行：
{"group": "12A", "students": [
{"name": "Ada", "marks": [91, 78, 95], "tutor": {"name": "Ms Khan", "room": "B12"}},
{"name": "Brian", "marks": [64, 70], "tutor": {"name": "Mr Obi", "room": "C3"}},
每一行是一个学生、一个完整的对象；第一行和最后一行负责把班级打开、合上。JSON 不在乎值与值之间的换行，所以这和分成许多缩进行的文件是同一份数据。

lineNotes.en: None is a single object, so the test is is, not ==.
lineNotes.zh: None 只有一个对象，所以用 is 判断，不用 ==。

lineNotes.en: Four steps down: a key, an index, a key, and an index counted from the end.
lineNotes.zh: 往下四步：一个键、一个下标、一个键、一个从末尾数的下标。

run.expect:
12A 3
Ms Khan
70
{'Ada': 88.0, 'Brian': 67.0, 'Chen': 87.0}
Ada B12
Brian C3
Chen no tutor
KeyError: Chen has no tutor key

blurb.en: Read key = value settings line by line into a dictionary of sections, skipping blank lines and comments and reporting the line number of anything it cannot understand.
blurb.zh: 一行一行读 key = value 形式的设置，存进按节分组的字典；跳过空行和注释，看不懂的行报出行号。

en: A parser turns text written for people into data a program can use. This one reads the kind of settings file many programs keep: [section] headers, key = value lines, # comments and blank lines. The result is a dictionary of dictionaries: one entry per section, each holding that section's settings.

The loop sorts every line into one of four kinds, in a fixed order. After strip(), an empty line or one starting with # is skipped. A line in square brackets opens a section. Anything else must be a setting - and if it has no equals sign, or nothing before it, it is an error. Checking in this order matters: a comment containing an equals sign must never be read as a setting.

partition splits a string at the first occurrence of a separator and always gives back three parts: what came before, the separator itself, and what came after. When the separator is missing, the middle part is an empty string, which is exactly how the parser notices a line with no equals sign. Only the first equals sign counts, so title = Space Race = Deluxe keeps its whole value, Space Race = Deluxe.

setdefault returns the dictionary for a section, creating an empty one only if the section is new, so a section that appears twice carries on where it left off rather than starting again. section always points at the dictionary currently being filled; storing into it stores into config, because both names refer to the same dictionary object. A key that repeats simply overwrites the old value: volume ends up 9, not 7. Every value is kept as a string - the parser cannot know that 800 is meant as a number - so the demo converts volume with int before adding 1, and prints 10.

Errors carry the line number, because a message without one is useless in a long file; enumerate starting at 1 counts lines the way people do. parse_config raises ValueError (see 「Files & Exceptions」) and parse_or_error turns it into a message. The three error demos: line 3, just some words, is not key = value; speed = 3 on line 1 comes before any section; and line 2, = 5, has no key.
zh: 解析器把写给人看的文本变成程序能用的数据。这个解析器读的是许多程序都有的那种设置文件：[section] 节头、key = value 行、# 注释和空行。结果是一个字典套字典：每个节一项，每项装着那一节的设置。
循环把每一行按固定顺序归进四类之一。strip() 之后，空行或以 # 开头的行跳过。方括号括起来的行开启一节。其余的必须是设置——没有等号、或等号前面什么都没有，就是错误。这个顺序要紧：一条含等号的注释绝不能被当成设置读进来。
partition 在分隔符第一次出现的地方把字符串切开，永远交回三部分：前面的、分隔符本身、后面的。找不到分隔符时中间那部分是空字符串——解析器正是靠这一点发现一行没有等号。只有第一个等号算数，所以 title = Space Race = Deluxe 保住了完整的值 Space Race = Deluxe。

setdefault 交回这一节的字典，只有这一节是新的时才建一个空字典，所以出现两次的节会接着上次继续填，而不是从头来。section 始终指向当前正在填的那个字典；往它里面存就是往 config 里存，因为两个名字指的是同一个字典对象。重复的键直接覆盖旧值：volume 最后是 9，不是 7。所有值都存成字符串——解析器没法知道 800 是个数——所以演示先用 int 转换 volume 再加 1，打印 10。

错误都带行号，因为长文件里没有行号的报错没法用；enumerate 从 1 开始，和人平时数行号的方式一致。parse_config 抛 ValueError（见「文件与异常」一页），parse_or_error 把它变成一条消息。三个错误演示：第 3 行 just some words 不是 key = value；第 1 行的 speed = 3 出现在任何一节之前；第 2 行 = 5 没有键。

lineNotes.at: if not sep or not key.strip():
lineNotes.en: sep is empty when there was no equals sign; the key is empty when the line started with one.
lineNotes.zh: 没有等号时 sep 是空的；一行以等号开头时键是空的。

lineNotes.at: for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
lineNotes.en: start=1 so the numbers match what an editor shows beside each line.
lineNotes.zh: start=1，行号就和编辑器每行旁边显示的一致。

run.expect:
{'display': {'width': '800', 'height': '600', 'title': 'Space Race = Deluxe'}, 'sound': {'volume': '9'}}
Space Race = Deluxe 10
error: line 3: expected key = value
error: line 1: speed is outside a section
error: line 2: expected key = value

blurb.en: Cut an arithmetic expression into its tokens - numbers, operators, brackets - by walking it one character at a time and remembering the number being built.
blurb.zh: 把算术表达式切成记号——数、运算符、括号——办法是一个字符一个字符地走，同时记住正在拼的那个数。

en: Before a program can work out 12*(3+45) it has to see it as a sequence of meaningful pieces, called tokens: 12, *, (, 3, +, 45, ). This first stage of reading a language is lexical analysis, and the function that does it is a tokeniser or lexer. It is the first stage of a compiler too. Turning the tokens into an answer is a separate job: the shunting yard algorithm on 「Stacks & Queues」 takes a token list exactly like this one.

The difficulty is that a number can be several characters long, so the loop needs to remember something between characters: the digits of the number it is building. That memory is the state. A digit adds to the number and moves on; the test is isdecimal(), because isdigit() also accepts superscripts such as ², which int() cannot read. Any other character first ends the number, if one is in progress, and then is dealt with itself: an operator or bracket becomes a token of its own, whitespace is skipped, and anything else is an error.

The step after the loop is easy to forget: if the text ends with a digit, the last number is still sitting in the state when the loop runs out, and has to be added by hand. Without that step 12*(3+45) would still work, since it ends with a bracket, but 3+45 would lose its 45.

An unknown character raises ValueError with a message naming it, shown with its quotes through the !r conversion (raise is covered on 「Files & Exceptions」). tokenise_or_none wraps it for callers that only want to know whether it worked.

The results: 12*(3+45) becomes 12, *, (, 3, +, 45 and ); spaces anywhere are ignored, so " 7 - 2/ 10 " becomes 7, -, 2, / and 10; ^ and x are not part of this little language and stop the tokeniser; and the empty string gives an empty list. The last line gives None for 4 % 2, and for 40 2 gives two tokens, 40 and 2: a tokeniser only cuts, it does not check that the tokens make sense in that order - that is the parser's job.
zh: 程序要算 12*(3+45)，得先把它看成一串有意义的片段，叫记号（token）：12、*、(、3、+、45、)。读一门语言的这第一步叫词法分析，做这件事的函数叫记号切分器（tokeniser，也叫 lexer）。编译器的第一个阶段也是它。把记号变成答案是另一件事：「栈与队列」一页的调度场算法收的正是这样一张记号表。
难处在于一个数可以有好几个字符，所以循环得在字符之间记住一点东西：正在拼的那个数的各位数字。这份记忆就是状态。遇到数字就接到数后面，继续走；判数字用 isdecimal()，因为 ² 这类上标 isdigit() 也认，却不是 int() 读得了的数字。遇到别的字符，先把正在拼的数（如果有）结束掉，再处理这个字符本身：运算符或括号自成一个记号，空白跳过，其他的就是错误。
循环之后那一步容易忘：文本以数字结尾时，循环走完了，最后一个数还待在状态里，得手动补进去。少了这一步，12*(3+45) 照样对，因为它以括号结尾；但 3+45 会丢掉 45。
遇到不认识的字符就抛 ValueError，消息里点出这个字符，通过 !r 转换带着引号显示（raise 见「文件与异常」一页）。tokenise_or_none 把它包一层，给只想知道成不成的调用者用。
结果：12*(3+45) 变成 12、*、(、3、+、45、)；哪里有空格都不管，所以 " 7 - 2/ 10 " 变成 7、-、2、/、10；^ 和 x 不属于这门小语言，切记号到这里就停下；空字符串得到空列表。最后一行对 4 % 2 得到 None，对 40 2 得到 40 和 2 两个记号：切记号只管切，不管这些记号按这个顺序合不合理——那是语法分析的事。

lineNotes.en: The step after the loop: a number at the very end of the text is still waiting in the state.
lineNotes.zh: 循环之后的那一步：文本最末尾的数还在状态里等着。

run.expect:
['12', '*', '(', '3', '+', '45', ')']
['7', '-', '2', '/', '10']
error: unexpected character '^'
error: unexpected character 'x'
[]
None ['40', '2']

blurb.en: The same tokeniser as one regular expression: a number or one operator, found everywhere by findall - plus a check that nothing was silently skipped.
blurb.zh: 同一个记号切分器，写成一个正则：一个数、或者一个运算符，由 findall 全部找出——再加一道检查，确认没有东西被悄悄跳过。

en: The vertical bar in a regex means or: the pattern matches either a run of digits or a single character from the class of operators and brackets. Inside square brackets most symbols lose their special meaning, but a minus between two characters means a range, so it is escaped with a backslash to mean just a minus. findall walks the text and collects every match, which is already the token list. Compare with Tokenise: Character by Character, where the same work takes a loop and a state variable: here the + after the digit class does the remembering.

re.compile turns the pattern into a pattern object once, at the top of the program, instead of every time tokenise runs; the object then has its own findall method. For a pattern used over and over, compiling it once and giving it a name also makes the code easier to read.

There is a catch. findall simply skips anything that does not match, so on its own it would turn 3 + x into 3 and + without a word of complaint - the last demo line shows it doing exactly that. The fix is a check: glue the tokens back together and compare with the original text with all its whitespace removed. If they differ, something was skipped that was not whitespace. On 3 + x the tokens glue to 3+ but the text without spaces is 3+x. The price is a vaguer message: this version knows that something is wrong but not which character.

The results: 12*(3+45) becomes 12, *, (, 3, +, 45 and ); spaces anywhere are ignored, so " 7 - 2/ 10 " becomes 7, -, 2, / and 10; ^ and x are not part of this little language and stop the tokeniser; and the empty string gives an empty list. The last line gives None for 4 % 2, and for 40 2 gives two tokens, 40 and 2: a tokeniser only cuts, it does not check that the tokens make sense in that order - that is the parser's job.
zh: 正则里的竖线表示「或」：模式匹配一串数字，或者运算符与括号那个字符类里的单个字符。方括号里大多数符号都失去特殊含义，但夹在两个字符中间的减号表示范围，所以前面加反斜杠转义，让它只表示减号。findall 走一遍文本、收集每处匹配，得到的就已经是记号表。和「切记号：逐字符」对照：那里同样的工作要一个循环加一个状态变量；这里是数字类后面的 + 在负责「记住」。
re.compile 在程序开头把模式变成一个模式对象，只做一次，而不是每次调用 tokenise 都做；这个对象自己有 findall 方法。一个反复使用的模式，编译一次、起个名字，代码也更好读。
有个陷阱。findall 把不匹配的东西直接跳过，所以单靠它，3 + x 会被切成 3 和 +，一声不吭——最后一行演示的正是这样。补救办法是一道检查：把记号拼回去，和去掉全部空白的原文比较。不相等，就说明有不是空白的东西被跳过了。对 3 + x，记号拼回去是 3+，而去掉空格的原文是 3+x。代价是消息更含糊：这个版本知道出了错，却不知道是哪个字符。
结果：12*(3+45) 变成 12、*、(、3、+、45、)；哪里有空格都不管，所以 " 7 - 2/ 10 " 变成 7、-、2、/、10；^ 和 x 不属于这门小语言，切记号到这里就停下；空字符串得到空列表。最后一行对 4 % 2 得到 None，对 40 2 得到 40 和 2 两个记号：切记号只管切，不管这些记号按这个顺序合不合理——那是语法分析的事。

lineNotes.en: The check can tell that something was skipped, not what - so the message cannot name the character.
lineNotes.zh: 这道检查只能知道有东西被跳过，不知道是什么——所以消息没法点出那个字符。

run.expect:
['12', '*', '(', '3', '+', '45', ')']
['7', '-', '2', '/', '10']
error: unexpected character in expression
error: unexpected character in expression
[]
None ['40', '2']
['3', '+'] 3+x

title.en: Parse a Log with Named Groups

blurb.en: Read a web server's log file, pull the IP address, method, path, status code and size out of each line with named groups, skip the lines that do not fit, and count the status codes.
blurb.zh: 读一个网站服务器的日志文件，用命名分组从每行取出 IP 地址、方法、路径、状态码和字节数，跳过不符合的行，再按状态码计数。

en: A log file records one event per line in a fixed layout; here each line is an IP address, a request method, a path, a three-digit status code and a size in bytes, separated by single spaces. Logs are too long to read by eye, so the usual job is to parse every line and summarise.

A named group, written with ?P and a name in angle brackets just inside the opening bracket, works like a numbered group but can be asked for by name: group("path") rather than group(3). groupdict() hands back every named group at once as a dictionary, so parse_line gets a ready-made record in one step and only has to convert status and size to int - a regex always captures text.

The pattern is long, so it is written as several raw strings inside one pair of round brackets. Python joins string literals that sit next to each other into one string, so this is exactly one pattern, just laid out a field per line. The pieces: dotted digits for the IP address (the dot is escaped, because an unescaped dot matches any character), capitals for the method, a slash followed by non-space characters for the path (backslash S is anything that is not whitespace), exactly three digits for the status and at least one digit for the size.

fullmatch means a line must fit from start to end, otherwise parse_line returns None and summarise counts it as bad and moves on. One bad line should never stop a program reading a long log. In this file there are 2 bad lines: the sentence that is not a log entry, and the request whose size is abc. The first line parses to 192.168.0.4, GET, /index.html and 200, and the second line's path is /about.html. Status 200 appears three times, 302 once and 404 once.
To run this in PyCharm you need the data file: make a folder called _fixtures next to the program and put a file access.log in it. It has these seven lines, one per paragraph below:
10.0.0.7 GET /about.html 200 2048
10.0.0.7 POST /login 302 0
192.168.0.4 GET /missing.png 404 512
this line is not a log entry
10.0.0.9 GET /admin 403 abc
The counting at the end is the get-with-a-default pattern from 「Dictionaries & Sets」, used as it is.
zh: 日志文件一行记录一件事，格式固定；这里每行依次是 IP 地址、请求方法、路径、三位的状态码、字节数，之间各隔一个空格。日志太长，靠眼睛读不过来，所以通常的活儿是逐行解析、再汇总。
命名分组在左括号里面紧跟着写 ?P 和尖括号里的名字，用起来和编号的分组一样，但可以按名字取：写 group("path")，不用写 group(3)。groupdict() 把全部命名分组一次装成字典交回，所以 parse_line 一步就拿到现成的记录，只需把 status 和 size 转成 int——正则抓到的永远是文本。
模式很长，所以写成一对圆括号里的好几个原始字符串。Python 会把挨在一起的字符串字面量连成一个字符串，所以这就是一个模式，只是一个字段占一行地摆开。各段：IP 地址是用点隔开的数字（点要转义，不转义的点匹配任意字符）；方法是大写字母；路径是一个斜杠后跟非空白字符（「反斜杠 S」是任何不是空白的字符）；状态码恰好三位数字；字节数至少一位数字。

fullmatch 要求一行从头到尾都符合，否则 parse_line 交回 None，summarise 把它算作坏行、接着往下走。一行坏数据绝不该让读长日志的程序停下来。这个文件里有 2 行坏行：那句不是日志的话，以及字节数写成 abc 的那个请求。第一行解析出 192.168.0.4、GET、/index.html 和 200，第二行的路径是 /about.html。状态码 200 出现三次，302 和 404 各一次。
要在 PyCharm 里跑，还得有这份数据文件：在程序旁边建一个叫 _fixtures 的文件夹，里面放 access.log，内容就是下面七行，一段一行：
10.0.0.7 GET /about.html 200 2048
10.0.0.7 POST /login 302 0
192.168.0.4 GET /missing.png 404 512
this line is not a log entry
10.0.0.9 GET /admin 403 abc
最后的计数是「字典与集合」一页里 get 带缺省值的写法，原样拿来用。

lineNotes.en: Each backslash-dot is a literal dot; each backslash-d-plus is one run of digits. It does not check that each number is at most 255.
lineNotes.zh: 每个「反斜杠 点」是一个真正的点；每个「反斜杠 d 加号」是一串数字。它不检查每个数是否不超过 255。

lineNotes.en: fullmatch: the whole line must fit, so trailing junk makes it a bad line too.
lineNotes.zh: fullmatch：整行都得符合，所以末尾多出东西也算坏行。
